bias.zh: 偏空 · 收于 200 日均线下方

read.en: Teradyne fell 4.5% on Oct 15 to $343.21 on heavy volume and is down 14% in five sessions. It closed just below the rising 200-day average ($344.1) and below its 5-day ($373.9), 10-day ($400.4), 30-day ($383.7) and 100-day ($382.1) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and has slipped below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($434.7), and RSI is 37.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 10月15日放量下跌 4.5%，收于 $343.21，五个交易日下跌 14%。股价收于上行的 200 日均线（$344.1）略下方，并位于 5 日（$373.9）、10 日（$400.4）、30 日（$383.7）和 100 日均线（$382.1）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，现已跌破零轴，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$434.7），RSI 为 37。

read.en: The 200-day average gave way on the close after the day's low of $331.89 undercut the Jun 9 low ($340.3). Resistance is $344–345 (200-day average, day's high), then $359–363 (Oct 14 close, Oct 13 low) and $374 (5-day). Support is $331.9 (Oct 15 low), then $326 (September lows) and $297–301 (late-July lows). A close below $326 would open $301.
